title: Region parts manifest
description: data/regions/parts/<region_id>/region.json — the core metadata of a region that is generated in parts (one file per borough/division), plus the list of those parts. `npm run merge-region` turns this and the part files into data/regions/<region_id>.geojson.

metadata.description: Exactly the metadata block of the merged region file, and the only place it is written. Sub-regions declared here are the region-wide divisions (the boroughs); a part may add divisions *inside* its own.

parts.description: The units of generation, in the order their facilities appear in the merged file. Doubles as the part-level request queue, exactly as data/regions/index.json does for whole regions: a part may sit at `requested` with no file at all.

id.description: Unique-within-region part slug. The part's file is always <id>.geojson next to this manifest.

subregion_id.description: The sub-region this part covers. Must be declared in metadata.subregions. Every facility in the part must sit in it or one of its descendants — that is what keeps two parts from claiming the same facility. Omit it for a part that is deliberately region-wide (an HQ/citywide part).

status.description: requested = queued, no file yet; in_progress = claimed; published = generated and merged.
